page.content:
Tripitaka — the Tang monk who must fetch the scriptures.

How Tang Sanzang connects

  • Faction: Tang pilgrimage — Sanzang is master of the scripture pilgrimage.
  • Character: Xuanzang — The historical Xuanzang is the model for Tang Sanzang.
  • Item: Tightening fillet — Sanzang recites the spell that tightens the fillet.
  • Character: Emperor Taizong — Taizong commissions Sanzang to fetch the scriptures.
  • Location: Chang'an — Sanzang's quest begins and must end in Chang'an.
  • Artist: White Bone Demon — The White Bone Demon hunts Sanzang's flesh in three disguises.

What is Tang Sanzang?

Tang Sanzang is the reincarnated disciple Gold Cicada, so compassionate he is almost helpless. Guanyin gives him disciples and the tight fillet to finish Xuanzang's work in romance form.

Key threads lead to Tang pilgrimage, Xuanzang, Tightening fillet, Emperor Taizong, Chang'an and White Bone Demon.
